decisions.question: Apa aturan utama, himpunan observasi dan arti hasilnya?
decisions.selected_rule: MANAGER-SELECTED ADDITION, 13 September 2026: primary geography is the verified common-boundary province universe, frozen from its authoritative code registry before outcomes are examined; years are all observed source waves in 2010–2022, excluding absent 2016. Use one fixed pooled-real-VA sector weight vector over the intersection of sectors with valid positive denominators in every compared province-year. Standardized CI_rt=sum_k(w_k*CI_rkt), where w_k is pooled real VA of sector k across the prespecified comparison cells divided by pooled real VA over their common sectors. Never renormalize by province. Empty support blocks the comparison; one surviving sector is labelled a single-sector comparison and is insufficient for the main composition-standardized manufacturing comparison. Export the retained sectors, counts and fraction of each province-year VA retained. A separately prespecified pairwise-province sensitivity uses each pair’s own common support and pooled weights over the same years, labelled a different target; pairwise estimates cannot be assembled into one common ranking.
decisions.rationale: Memenuhi permintaan Word tanpa mengubah arti input atau menambah asumsi tersembunyi.
